description: Enhanced transport-security edge cases: a plaintext request to a TLS-enabled service is always answered with a permanent redirect (301) to the secure scheme, and the redirect target preserves the original path and query string (with ampersands HTML-escaped) for methods that emit a redirect body, while methods that do not emit a body (HEAD, PUT) produce an empty body. Each registration reports success and each probe reports the response status with the body.

cases.expected_output: deploy s1 ok status=301 target=Moved Permanently.

deploy s1 ok
status=301 target=
status=301 target=
